methods.label: Reverse the translation
methods.explanation: \(A\to A'\) is a translation 4 units to the right and 3 units upward, so the coordinates of \(B\) are obtained by translating \(B'\) in the reverse direction: \((6-4,1-3)=(2,-2)\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 coordinate translations and subtraction to recover an original point.
